sn22.89:4.11: They were mistaken, as will be made clear later. A stream-enterer does not regard the aggregates as self, in the sense that they cannot form a view to that effect.
sn22.89:5.9: The key difference here is between “I am” (_asmi_), the intuitive sense of being someone, and “I am that” (_ayamahamasmi_), the identification of the self with something in particular, namely the aggregates (see [mn47:13.4]() and note). | Read _avigataṁ_ per [sn22.47:2.1]().
